list_source: Official trophy list as published by PlayStation, reported 18 Nov 2026 from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements (see sources on each trophy).

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the payoff, not a task of its own: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then strangers and side missions, then collectibles, activities and money — and check the tracker here so nothing is left behind. The full list is 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze, all single-player and offline.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the game's first mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn — just follow the on-screen objectives and finish the mission. It is a hidden trophy, so it stays secret on PlayStation until it pops.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the game's own checklist, tracked in the pause menu. The visible trophies already show most of what it covers: the story, 250 stunts, 100 WAiNK spots, 3 card sets, every meditation spot, all garages and 5 bank vaults. Finish every other trophy and the 100% checklist together; this gold is effectively the last step before the platinum. Expect a long haul — launch reporting puts the platinum around 200 hours.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida — jumps, near misses, airtime and other driving feats the game counts as a stunt. The counter is tracked by PlayStation, so any stunt counts toward the total; grind them while travelling between missions instead of in one sitting, and use fast vehicles and ramps to chain them. A long but passive grind that finishes itself during normal play.

roadmap.title: Play the story — Chapters 1–4 and the finale
roadmap.text: Finish Gone Fishing, Chapters 1–4 and the final mission (trophies 2–13). Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one more right before the final mission: launch reporting says the game has no mission replay, so a save is your only way back.

roadmap.title: Do the one missable thing first
roadmap.text: Before Chapter 1 ends, meditate at the spot on Lucia's balcony — it disappears after the chapter. That is the single trophy launch guides flag as possibly missable (Positive Mental Attitude). Everything else can be earned after the story.

roadmap.title: Strangers and side missions
roadmap.text: Finish the stranger strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — and any 8 strands in total for the silver. These unlock as the story progresses, so work them between chapters.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploring Leonida
roadmap.text: WAiNK It at 100 locations, 3 card sets, 18 meditation spots, 100 vehicles discovered and all 52 areas of Leonida. Collect while travelling for other trophies and sweep what is left at the end.

roadmap.title: Activities and challenges
roadmap.text: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a Top Fun drone-race win at all 14 locations, 20 different races won, fishing vs Cal, an arcade game, bowling and 50 challenges. Sampling every activity also earns Master of None.

roadmap.title: Money and robberies
roadmap.text: 5 bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store undetected, one illegal operation per gang, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent and all 8 garages. Robberies feed the laundering total, and garages count toward 100% completion.

roadmap.title: The small moments, then the platinum
roadmap.text: Mop up the moment trophies (Ocean Beach cocktail, showroom smash, the strange sighting, the melee drive-by and the rest), finish the 100% completion checklist for A Long Road, and Vice Got a Price! pops with it.

notes.missable: Only one trophy is flagged as possibly missable by launch guides: Positive Mental Attitude (meditate at every spot — the Chapter 1 balcony spot disappears after the chapter). No mission replay is reported, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.
notes.online: There are no online trophies. All 55 are single-player and offline.
notes.cheats: Turning on a cheat disables trophies (per PowerPyx, via Planet GTA 6) — and once used, you cannot save. Finish the trophy hunt before touching cheats; cheats only unlock after the story in any case.
notes.time: Launch reporting puts the platinum at around 200 hours; the story alone takes around 60 hours.
notes.sources_note: Trophy names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it, reported 18 Nov 2026 from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements. Guide text is this entry's own words; every trophy cites its sources.
